title: Mailbox/queryChanges ignores the filter and sort arguments
description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_query_changes passes None/None for filter and sort to backend.query_changes::<Mailbox>, so a filtered Mailbox/queryChanges returns the unfiltered delta and never validates the filter (RFC 8620 §5.6: filter/sort are the same as the original /query). Found while working JMAP-v4eq. Fix: decode with jmap_server::filter_arg::<MailboxFilterCondition> (unsupportedFilter on unknown keys) and forward it, mirroring handle_mailbox_query.
